chunks: Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
It is incumbent upon the Imam to pray the zuhr salat in Minā, then spend the night there, and remain until the sun rises; then he should depart to ʿArafāt.

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the leader responsible for performing and guiding the rite
key_terms.بِمِنًى: in Minā, the hajj location where pilgrims stay before ʿArafāt
key_terms.تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ: the sun rises, marking the time after which departure occurs
key_terms.عَرَفَاتٍ: ʿArafāt, the major hajj station to which one proceeds

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about when the Imam should leave Minā for ʿArafāt during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states the prescribed practice for the Imam during the hajj rites: to perform the zuhr salat in Minā, stay there overnight, and leave for ʿArafāt after sunrise. It reflects an ordered legal ruling concerning the timing and sequence of movement in the pilgrimage.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2976 - Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"It is incumbent upon the Imam to pray the Zuhr prayer in Mina, spend the night there, and remain until sunrise. Then, he should depart for Arafat."
